meta.title: Mehul Singh - Founder & Chief Architect, Eigient
meta.description: Mehul Singh, Founder & Chief Architect of Eigient. Computational systems built from first principles.

profile.headline: Computational systems, built from first principles.
summary: I am a systems architect and the founder of Eigient, a firm working at the intersection of computational physics, artificial intelligence and algorithmic engineering.

My work is characterised by a refusal to assemble from off-the-shelf parts. I take a problem down to its base assumptions and rebuild it so that the structure, the mathematics and the execution hold together under load

perspective.label: Perspective
perspective.quote: A system is only as sound as the assumption it rests on. I would rather spend a month finding that assumption than a year building on the wrong one.

eigient.label: Eigient
eigient.name: Eigient
eigient.description: Eigient is a research laboratory advancing computational physics, artificial intelligence and algorithmic engineering. As founder and chief architect, I set the technical direction and lead the design of its core systems.

work.label: Record of work
work.intro: A selection of systems built end to end. The full engineering portfolio is maintained separately.

items.title: BBRES-RNG entropy engine
items.outcome: Scheduler-nondeterminism entropy source for CSPRNG seeding; 7.999952 of 8.0 bits Shannon entropy, passed NIST SP 800-22 and adversarial machine-learning attack.

items.title: Secure-by-design operating system
items.outcome: Founder and lead systems engineer of an open-source kernel: pre-emptive scheduling, memory management and bare-metal execution.

items.title: Inpherra
items.outcome: A deep-learning framework written from scratch in Rust - tensors, computational graphs, automatic differentiation and optimisers.

items.title: yourNode
items.outcome: End-to-end encrypted, serverless remote access to one's own machine, with no third-party storage.
